title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an… (CVE-2026-80508)
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 have an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated local attacker to gain filesystem access. This flaw could enable attackers to bypass authentication controls by spoofing, potentially leading to unauthorized access to sensitive files.
